# PAP India (Property Aligners & Planners) — full reference

> Mall management consultancy operating across India. PAP India plans, leases, launches and operates malls, high streets and mixed-use retail assets: mall operations, leasing and zoning, pre-construction feasibility and planning support, launch marketing and ongoing sustenance and reporting. Portfolio of 5.2 million sq ft across retail, commercial and cinemas.

## Services

### Research & feasibility

Understanding what the catchment actually supports before a single lease is signed.

- Traffic & footfall potential: consumer behaviour
- Competitor analysis: existing malls, high streets, retail destinations
- Need-gap identification: services & brand categories
- Feasibility study: ROI & zoning recommendations

### Leasing & zoning

Building the mix, then closing it: collateral, outreach, paperwork and onboarding.

- Zoning & category planning
- Target brand shortlist & outreach
- Leasing brochures & videos
- Execution: LOIs, agreements, fit-out guidelines
- Tenant onboarding support

### Operations & technology

The systems and people that keep the asset running from day one.

- Vendor appointments: security, housekeeping, parking, maintenance
- SOP development: operations, fit-out, cleaning, security, utilities
- Technology setup: CCTV, PMS, energy systems
- Parking & EV integration
- Manpower hiring & training

### Marketing & launch

Getting the opening right, then keeping footfall coming back.

- Pre-launch strategy and PR planning
- Grand launch event: celebrity, media, festive activities
- Marketing calendar push: OOH, digital, local radio
- Tenant support promotions
- Loyalty & travel tie-ups

### Sustenance & reporting

Ongoing visibility for owners and investors, quarter after quarter.

- Monthly reports on leasing, ops and marketing
- Sales & footfall analytics dashboards
- Footfall monitoring tools
- Quarterly review & planning sessions
- Annual budget alignment

## Approach: four phases in sequence

- **Need gap analysis**: Check brand potential of the local populace and understand floating traffic to build the right leasing plan.
- **Pre-launch preps**: Ensure technical, BMS, security and operations are set up correctly to avoid recurring issues post launch. SOPs, manuals, leasing and ROI calculations.
- **Launch phase**: PR plans, a 360-degree marketing plan, launch event, and implementation of SOPs for ops, security, housekeeping, BMS and technical systems.
- **Sustenance**: Ongoing mall operations, marketing and churn across leasing, maintenance, AMCs, security, housekeeping upgrades and marketing calendars.

Engagements are scoped by phase: land/concept, pre-launch, launch, operational asset or turnaround.

## What owners get

- **High footfall**: Attracts the right target audience based on catchment analysis.
- **Optimised brand mix**: The right combination of anchors, local favourites and new-age brands.
- **Faster leasing**: Easier to onboard brands with clear positioning and market potential.
- **Early profitability**: Faster breakeven through efficient space utilisation and better tenant performance.
- **Targeted marketing**: Promotions and events tailored to consumer preferences and behaviour.
- **Lower vacancy & churn**: Brands sustain longer on the back of better footfall and sales.
- **Efficient space zoning**: Layouts aligned with consumer flow and retail psychology.
- **Investor confidence**: Data-backed plans inspire trust among stakeholders.
- **Smooth launch execution**: Pre-launch planning ensures momentum from day one.
- **Sustainable growth**: Scalable operations and adaptable strategies for long-term success.

## Key projects

- **Wave One, Noida** (Mixed use, Noida) — 3.53 acres · 40 storeys. A 40-storey mixed-use landmark in Noida: premium retail, office space, cinema and food court on a 3.53-acre land parcel.
- **Wave Mall, Ludhiana** (Mall, Ludhiana) — 2.85 lakh sq ft GLA. Wave Mall Ludhiana with 2.85 lakh Sq ft GLA situated on Ferozepur Road. All the malls are managed along with Wave One Movies, 12 screens.
- **Wave Mall, Jammu** (Mall, Jammu) — 2.80 lakh sq ft GLA. Wave Mall Jammu with GLA of 2.80 lakh Sq Ft situated on Srinagar Highway.
- **Wave One Club** (Lifestyle, Noida) — 50,000 sq ft. 50000 sqft premium lifestyle club in the heart of Noida.
- **Aero District** (Retail, Ludhiana) — Phase 1 - 2.6 L sqft. Upcoming retail project in Ludhiana. Project - 6.5 Acres of mix used.
- **Vardhman Amrante** (Mall, Ludhiana) — 2.7 lakh sq ft. Amrante on Chandigarh Road is an upcoming 2.7 lakhs sqft mall with a blend of dining, retail and entertainment. Expected to launch in June 2026.
- **Sabarmati HSR Hub** (Transit-oriented, Sabarmati, Gujarat) — 13.78 lakh sq ft. India's first global-standard transit-oriented development, anchored by the country's first bullet train station with metro and rail connectivity. The Hub combines concourse retail, large fine dining and food courts, and world-class office space, positioning Sabarmati as the gateway of India's TOD transformation.
- **Palm Walk Mall** (Hybrid retail, Ludhiana) — 9 acres. Ludhiana's first hybrid retail destination, spanning 9 acres along Sidhwan Canal Road. It uniquely blends a high-street (open-air) layout with a traditional air-conditioned mall format. Operational and most sought development in Ludhiana.
- **Florence** (Residential, Ludhiana) — 25 acres. 25 acres of residential project at south city road, Ludhiana.
- **Royal Green Realty** (Upcoming, Gurugram & Bahadurgarh) — Two projects. Courtyard 37, Sector 37 D Gurugram and Royal Green Bahadurgarh are upcoming projects. We are at phase 2 of the development and leasing is in full swing for 37 D, whereas Bahadurgarh is slated for subsequent development by late 2027.

## Frequently asked questions

### Do you work on projects that are still at land stage?

Yes. Concept-to-commissioning is the core of what we do: land use and blueprint planning through to daily operations.

### Can you take on an operational mall that is underperforming?

Yes. Reviving struggling malls into profitable assets is one of our two main mandates, alongside launching new ones.

### Do you handle marketing and events in-house?

We have a dedicated in-house event management team rather than relying solely on external planners, which keeps execution and turnaround under one roof.

### Can we engage you for a single phase only?

Yes. Engagements are scoped by phase: research and feasibility, leasing, operations setup, launch marketing, or ongoing sustenance.

### Which cities do you operate in?

Current projects span Noida, Ludhiana, Jammu, Gurugram, Bahadurgarh and Sabarmati, and we take on assets across India.

## Mall management FAQs

### What does a mall management company do?

It runs a retail asset end to end on the owner’s behalf: feasibility and zoning before construction, leasing and tenant mix, operations and facility setup, launch and seasonal marketing, and the monthly reporting that keeps owners and investors informed.

### How is mall management different from facility management?

Facility management covers the hard services — security, housekeeping, maintenance and utilities. Mall management is the wider commercial mandate: leasing and tenant mix strategy, marketing and footfall generation, tenant relations and owner reporting. PAP India runs both under one team.

### When should a developer engage a mall management company?

Before construction, if possible. GLA, zoning and brand-mix decisions taken on catchment data decide how the asset performs for years after launch. PAP India also takes over operational malls that need a turnaround.

### How are mall management services priced in India?

Engagements are scoped, not flat-rate: by phase — feasibility, leasing, operations setup, launch marketing or sustenance — and by the size and condition of the asset. Share the site and the stage you’re at for a scoped proposal.

### Which cities does PAP India work in?

Current assets are in Noida, Ludhiana, Jammu, Gurugram, Bahadurgarh and Sabarmati, and we take on retail assets across India.
